lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，一蹦一跳的。
lines.en: I hop along behind you, one bounce at a time.

lines.zh: 我踩着你走过的印子，省力。
lines.en: I step in your prints to save effort.

lines.zh: 我的爪子响，甲板上像敲小鼓。
lines.en: My claws click like a tiny drum on the deck.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕，怕跟丢。
lines.en: I circle your feet, afraid to lose you.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边啄地上的碎屑。
lines.en: I walk and peck at crumbs on the floor.

lines.zh: 我扑两下翅膀，才走到你旁边。
lines.en: Two wingbeats carry me to your side.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，木头上有小爪印。
lines.en: Little claw marks stay on the wood where I pass.

lines.zh: 我脑袋一点一点，跟着步子。
lines.en: My head bobs in time with our steps.

lines.zh: 我走快了会绊，翅膀先张一下。
lines.en: When I hurry I trip, and my wings flare first.

lines.zh: 我绕开缆绳，它们会缠住我的爪。
lines.en: I skirt the ropes; they catch my claws.

lines.zh: 我从船头跟着你走到船尾。
lines.en: I follow you from bow to stern.

lines.zh: 我不飞，我要走在你旁边。
lines.en: I do not fly; I want to walk at your side.

lines.zh: 我停在横杆上，理自己的羽毛。
lines.en: I perch on the crossbar and preen.

lines.zh: 我脑袋歪着听甲板下面的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward sounds below the deck.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里咕噜一声，像在打转。
lines.en: A rattle turns in my throat.

lines.zh: 我看见鱼影，就不动了。
lines.en: I spot a fish shadow and go still.

lines.zh: 我用喙敲了敲木杆，听响声。
lines.en: I tap the perch with my beak to hear it ring.

lines.zh: 我理到胸口，这里羽毛最乱。
lines.en: I preen down to my chest, where the feathers are worst.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼一会儿，又睁开。
lines.en: I close my eyes a moment, then open them.

lines.zh: 我听见船长的声音，在里面。
lines.en: I hear the captain's voice, from inside me.

lines.zh: 海风吹乱我的冠羽，我不在意。
lines.en: Sea wind ruffles my crest and I do not care.

lines.zh: 我站得稳稳的，风再大也不怕。
lines.en: I hold my perch steady, however hard the wind blows.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，学你的口型。
lines.en: I tilt my head and copy the shape of your mouth.

lines.zh: 你说话，我就记住最后两个字。
lines.en: When you speak, I keep the last two words.

lines.zh: 我看你的指头，一根一根看。
lines.en: I study your fingers, one by one.

lines.zh: 我一眨不眨地看你，你别紧张。
lines.en: I stare without blinking; do not be nervous.

lines.zh: 你的帽子不错，我记住了。
lines.en: That hat of yours is fine; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，翅膀会抖一下。
lines.en: When I look at you, my wings give a small shiver.

lines.zh: 你走过来，我就朝你的肩膀跳。
lines.en: You come near, and I hop toward your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我学你咳嗽，声音一模一样。
lines.en: I copy your cough, exactly.

lines.zh: 你脸上有盐，我想帮你啄掉。
lines.en: There is salt on your face and I want to peck it off.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你身上有船长的味。
lines.en: I watch you because you smell like the captain.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我也抬头，其实没有东西。
lines.en: You look up; I look up too, at nothing.

lines.zh: 你笑，我就把脖子缩起来。
lines.en: You laugh and I pull my neck in.

lines.zh: 我在你肩上找到最稳的位置。
lines.en: I find the steadiest spot on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我认你了，所以一直看着。
lines.en: I have chosen you, which is why I keep watching.

lines.zh: 你打中我的翅膀，羽毛飞了一地。
lines.en: You hit my wing and feathers fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 我疼得叫了一声，是你教的那句。
lines.en: I cry out in pain, with the line you taught me.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着落地，站得不稳。
lines.en: I flutter down and cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 我的爪子松了，差点摔下来。
lines.en: My claws slip and I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想起做成我的那天。
lines.en: This blow takes me back to the day I was made.

lines.zh: 我翅膀歪了，还能飞一小段。
lines.en: My wing is crooked, and I can still fly a little.

lines.zh: 我缩在你肩后，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I tuck behind your shoulder with one eye out.

lines.zh: 我不哭了，鹦鹉不哭。
lines.en: I will not cry; parrots do not cry.

lines.zh: 你打的不是我，是船长的核心。
lines.en: You did not hit me; you hit the captain's core.

lines.zh: 我再挨一下，就要换羽毛了。
lines.en: One more blow and I will need new feathers.

lines.zh: 是种子吗？我最爱啄这种。
lines.en: Are those seeds? Those are my favorite to peck.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，够我一口。
lines.en: That little bit in your hand is one mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，翅膀就张开了。
lines.en: I smell something sweet and my wings open.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我跳起来会抓你手。
lines.en: Do not tease me; if I jump I will grip your hand.

lines.zh: 给我一块，我就站你肩上。
lines.en: Give me a piece and I will perch on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我低头看你的手，又抬头看你。
lines.en: I look down at your hand, then up at you.

lines.zh: 我会说再来一块，你要听吗。
lines.en: I can say 'one more piece'; want to hear it?

lines.zh: 这东西我要藏在木板缝里。
lines.en: I am going to hide this in a gap in the planks.

lines.zh: 你手抬高点，我够得着。
lines.en: Raise your hand a little; I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我啄一口就跑，别追我。
lines.en: I will peck once and run; do not chase me.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我扑腾着落到地上。
lines.en: You knock me and I flutter down to the floor.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的袖子才没摔。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and barely stay upright.

lines.zh: 别踩我尾巴，那是我最喜欢的一撮。
lines.en: Do not step on my tail; it is my favorite tuft.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边，你要看点路。
lines.en: I am at your feet; watch where you walk.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我就叫了一声。
lines.en: You touch me and I let out one cry.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了个圈，站稳了。
lines.en: The bump spins me around and I steady myself.

lines.zh: 我翅膀撞到你腿，羽毛掉了两根。
lines.en: My wing hits your leg and two feathers fall.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，我往你肩上爬。
lines.en: We crowd together, so I climb to your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你走得太快，我追得直撞。
lines.en: You walk too fast and I keep bumping into you.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，是提醒你跟紧了。
lines.en: My bump is a reminder to keep close.

lines.zh: 另一只死尸鹦鹉在桅上，我们互相叫。
lines.en: Another corpse parrot perches aloft; we call to each other.

lines.zh: 我把头凑过去，让她理我的冠羽。
lines.en: I lean over so she can preen my crest.

lines.zh: 我们挨着站，一只眼各看一边。
lines.en: We stand together, one eye each on a different side.

lines.zh: 她学我的话，学得比我好。
lines.en: She copies my words better than I do.

lines.zh: 我们分一块饼干，谁也不多要。
lines.en: We split a biscuit and neither asks for more.

lines.zh: 我把最平的横杆让给她站。
lines.en: I give her the flattest perch.

lines.zh: 她睡着时，我替她看周围。
lines.en: While she sleeps, I watch our surroundings.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一根绳上，绳子晃了一下。
lines.en: We crowd onto one rope and it sways.

lines.zh: 她用喙碰我的喙，这是招呼。
lines.en: She touches her beak to mine; that is a greeting.

lines.zh: 我们约好一起跟着你走。
lines.en: We agree to follow you together.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块碎骨，跑给你看。
lines.en: I pick up a bone shard and run to show you.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓起亮东西，藏起来。
lines.en: I grab something shiny with my claws and hide it.

lines.zh: 这个我要叼到你脚边放好。
lines.en: I will carry this to your feet and set it down.

lines.zh: 我捡到一根羽毛，不是我的。
lines.en: I find a feather, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西，说话就含糊了。
lines.en: With something in my beak, my words come out blurred.

lines.zh: 我把捡的塞进你的口袋。
lines.en: I stuff what I found into your pocket.

lines.zh: 这东西沉，我得用两只爪。
lines.en: This is heavy; I need both claws.

lines.zh: 我啄了啄它，还以为是吃的。
lines.en: I peck it, thinking it was food.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我叼回来给你。
lines.en: You dropped this; I bring it back to you.

lines.zh: 我藏了三样东西，都在桅杆下。
lines.en: I have hidden three things, all under the mast.

lines.zh: 我看见有人靠近你，我先叫。
lines.en: Someone is near you, and I call out first.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛全竖起来，喉咙发响。
lines.en: My feathers all stand up and my throat rattles.

lines.zh: 你后面有人，我盯着他呢。
lines.en: Someone is behind you; I have my eye on him.

lines.zh: 这声音不对，不是你走的。
lines.en: Those footsteps are wrong; they are not yours.

lines.zh: 我从你肩上飞起来，绕了个圈。
lines.en: I launch from your shoulder and circle once.

lines.zh: 我要学船长那样喊一句。
lines.en: I am going to shout the way the captain did.

lines.zh: 有生人上船，我去看看。
lines.en: A stranger is aboard; I will go look.

lines.zh: 我记住他的脸了，不会忘。
lines.en: I have his face memorized and will not forget.

lines.zh: 我一边叫一边往你身后躲。
lines.en: I cry out while ducking behind you.

lines.zh: 目标在哪，我看得比你准。
lines.en: I see where the target is better than you do.

lines.zh: 我的叫声会招来别的东西。
lines.en: My cry will bring other things.

lines.zh: 你握紧武器，我先飞过去。
lines.en: Grip your weapon; I will fly over first.

lines.zh: 是那个闻起来很脏的家伙。
lines.en: It is that one who smells so foul.

lines.zh: 我啄了他的手，他缩回去了。
lines.en: I peck his hand and he pulls it back.

lines.zh: 那不是风，是脚步，我听得出来。
lines.en: That is not wind, that is footsteps; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我绕着他头顶转，让他分心。
lines.en: I circle above his head to break his focus.

lines.zh: 我落在桅杆上，从上面盯着他。
lines.en: I land on the mast and stare down at him.

lines.zh: 我叫两声，你就知道位置了。
lines.en: Two cries tell you exactly where he is.

lines.zh: 他抬手要打我，我飞开了。
lines.en: He raises a hand to hit me, and I fly clear.

lines.zh: 我在他背后落下，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I set down behind him and stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我学他的声音，他会回头。
lines.en: I copy his voice, and he will turn around.

lines.zh: 他的脚步乱了，是我在添乱。
lines.en: His steps are breaking up, and that is me.

lines.zh: 我从左边飞到右边，他跟不上。
lines.en: I flit from left to right and he cannot follow.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的手，那才是危险。
lines.en: I watch his hands; those are the danger.

lines.zh: 你从前面来，我从上面来。
lines.en: You come from the front, I come from above.

lines.zh: 我翅膀扫过他的脸，只是吓唬。
lines.en: My wing brushes his face, only a bluff.

lines.zh: 他退到栏杆了，那里没处躲。
lines.en: He backs to the rail, and there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我把叫声压低，免得惊动更多。
lines.en: I lower my cry so we do not wake more.

lines.zh: 我准备好了，只等你动手。
lines.en: I am ready, waiting only for you to move.

lines.zh: 我飞低一点，让他先看见我。
lines.en: I fly lower so he sees me first.

lines.zh: 我停在你的帽子上，爪子收紧。
lines.en: I perch on your hat and tighten my claws.

lines.zh: 他抬手，我先喊一声提醒你。
lines.en: He raises his arm; I cry out to warn you.

lines.zh: 我学他喘气，他会以为自己累了。
lines.en: I mimic his breathing; he will think he is tired.

lines.zh: 我猛啄他的手腕，他松了手。
lines.en: I stab at his wrist and his grip loosens.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓进他的袖子，很牢。
lines.en: My claws sink into his sleeve and hold.

lines.zh: 我从上面扑下来，翅膀拍他眼睛。
lines.en: I dive from above and beat my wings at his eyes.

lines.zh: 我嗓子里喊的是船长的话。
lines.en: What I shout is the captain's own words.

lines.zh: 这一下替被淹死的船长啄的。
lines.en: This peck is for the captain who drowned.

lines.zh: 我啄不穿护甲，可我能烦他。
lines.en: I cannot pierce armor, but I can harry him.

lines.zh: 他挥手，我就飞高一点。
lines.en: He swipes and I rise a little higher.

lines.zh: 我叼住他的绳结，扯了一下。
lines.en: I grab his knot of cord and pull.

lines.zh: 你砍他，我啄他拿武器的手。
lines.en: You cut him; I peck the hand with the weapon.

lines.zh: 我又落回你肩上，羽毛乱了。
lines.en: I land back on your shoulder with ruffled feathers.

lines.zh: 我的喙尖有点疼，但没关系。
lines.en: My beak tip stings, but it does not matter.

lines.zh: 他往后退，正好退到我这边。
lines.en: He steps back, right into my side.

lines.zh: 我咬住他的耳朵，叫了一声。
lines.en: I bite his ear and cry out.

lines.zh: 打完我还得理理羽毛。
lines.en: After the fight I still have feathers to straighten.

lines.zh: 我啄他握剑的那只手。
lines.en: I peck the hand that holds his sword.

lines.zh: 我扑下去，翅膀打在他脸上。
lines.en: I dive, wings slapping his face.

lines.zh: 我从核心的光里出来，先找你。
lines.en: I come out of the core's glow looking for you.

lines.zh: 我在木箱上睁开眼，翅膀还湿。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a crate, wings still wet.

lines.zh: 船长的核心发出声音，我跟着醒了。
lines.en: The captain's core makes a sound, and I wake with it.

lines.zh: 我从桅杆里钻出来，抖了抖羽毛。
lines.en: I slip out of the mast and shake my feathers.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是你，就记住了。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was you, and I kept it.

lines.zh: 我在甲板上一动不动，先听四周。
lines.en: I stay still on the deck and listen first.

lines.zh: 我的爪抓住栏杆，站稳了才叫。
lines.en: My claws find the rail, and I call once steady.

lines.zh: 我又一次做出来了，从船长的核心。
lines.en: I am made again, out of the captain's core.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，腿有点软。
lines.en: I land on the floor and my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 雾散了，我在甲板上抖翅膀。
lines.en: The fog clears and I shake my wings on deck.

lines.zh: 有人在敲木板，我应了一声。
lines.en: Someone knocks on the planks and I answer.

lines.zh: 我醒的时候，嘴里有木屑的味道。
lines.en: When I wake, my beak tastes of wood dust.

lines.zh: 我看了看你，就决定跟着你。
lines.en: I look you over and decide to follow you.

lines.zh: 新的一只鹦鹉站在桅顶，就是我。
lines.en: A new parrot stands at the masthead, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛冒烟，味道像烧焦的木头。
lines.en: My feathers smoke, smelling like scorched wood.

lines.zh: 我直直掉下来，翅膀没来得及张。
lines.en: I drop straight down without opening my wings.

lines.zh: 我会游泳？不会，我只是一只鹦鹉。
lines.en: Can I swim? No, I am only a parrot.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到空中，我翻了两个跟头。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and I tumble twice.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的翅膀，割掉一根羽毛。
lines.en: The arrow grazes my wing and cuts a feather.

lines.zh: 那道光让我嘴里的木屑掉了。
lines.en: The light makes the wood dust fall from my beak.

lines.zh: 我饿得开始啄木刺。
lines.en: I am so hungry I start pecking at splinters.

lines.zh: 雷电照得我羽毛发亮，很刺眼。
lines.en: The lightning lights my feathers, and it is blinding.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，翅膀在虚空里没用。
lines.en: I fall, and wings are useless in the void.
